001package org.clafer.choco.search;
002
003import java.util.Random;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.search.strategy.selectors.values.SetValueSelector;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
006import org.chocosolver.util.objects.setDataStructures.ISetIterator;
007
008/**
009 *
010 * @author jimmy
011 */
012public class RandomSetValueSelector implements SetValueSelector {
013
014    private final Random rand;
015
016    public RandomSetValueSelector(Random rand) {
017        this.rand = rand;
018    }
019
020    @Override
021    public int selectValue(SetVar s) {
022        int m = rand.nextInt(s.getUB().size() - s.getLB().size());
023        ISetIterator iter = s.getUB().iterator();
024        while (iter.hasNext()) {
025            int i = iter.nextInt();
026            if (!s.getLB().contains(i)) {
027                if (m == 0) {
028                    return i;
029                }
030                m--;
031            }
032        }
033        throw new IllegalStateException();
034    }
035}
